title: 第12课 · 你穿得太少了
subtitle: HSK 2 · Lesson 12 — 你穿得太少了 · You wear too little

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在教室 — In the classroom

items.py: A: Nǐ měi tiān zǎoshang jǐ diǎn qǐ chuáng?
items.en: A: What time do you get up every morning?

items.py: B: Liù diǎn duō.
items.en: B: A bit after six.

items.py: A: Nǐ bǐ wǒ zǎo qǐ yí ge xiǎoshí.
items.en: A: You get up an hour earlier than me.

items.zh: B：我睡得也早，我每天晚上十点就睡觉。早睡早起身体好。
items.py: B: Wǒ shuì de yě zǎo, wǒ měi tiān wǎnshang shí diǎn jiù shuì jiào. Zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ shēntǐ hǎo.
items.en: B: I go to bed early too — at ten every night. Early to bed, early to rise is healthy.

data.topic: 课文2 · 2. 在朋友家 — At a friend's home

items.zh: A：再来点儿米饭吧，你吃得太少了。
items.py: A: Zài lái diǎnr mǐfàn ba, nǐ chī de tài shǎo le.
items.en: A: Have some more rice — you've eaten too little.

items.zh: B：不少了，今天吃得很好，太谢谢你了。
items.py: B: Bù shǎo le, jīntiān chī de hěn hǎo, tài xièxie nǐ le.
items.en: B: Not at all, I've eaten very well today. Thank you so much.

items.py: A: Nǐ zuò fàn zuò de zěnmeyàng?
items.en: A: How well do you cook?

items.zh: B：不怎么样，我妻子比我做得好。
items.py: B: Bù zěnmeyàng, wǒ qīzi bǐ wǒ zuò de hǎo.
items.en: B: Not very well. My wife cooks better than me.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在家门口 — At the door of the house

items.py: A: Xià xuě le, jīntiān zhēn lěng.
items.en: A: It's snowing. It's really cold today.

items.py: B: Yǒu líng xià shí dù ba?
items.en: B: It must be ten below zero.

items.zh: A：是啊，你穿得太少了，我们进房间吧。
items.py: A: Shì a, nǐ chuān de tài shǎo le, wǒmen jìn fángjiān ba.
items.en: A: Yes, and you're wearing too little. Let's go inside.

items.py: B: Hǎo ba.
items.en: B: OK.

data.topic: 课文4 · 4. 在家里 — At home

items.py: A: Nǐ zài máng shénme ne?
items.en: A: What are you busy with?

items.zh: B：我弟弟让我帮他找个房子，现在他家离公司有点儿远。
items.py: B: Wǒ dìdi ràng wǒ bāng tā zhǎo ge fángzi, xiànzài tā jiā lí gōngsī yǒudiǎnr yuǎn.
items.en: B: My younger brother asked me to find him a flat — he lives a bit far from his company.

items.py: A: Zhù de yuǎn zhēn de hěn lèi!
items.en: A: Living far away is really tiring!

items.zh: B：是啊，他也希望能住得近一点儿。
items.py: B: Shì a, tā yě xīwàng néng zhù de jìn yìdiǎnr.
items.en: B: Yes, he wants to live a bit closer too.
